case_analysis.apparent_benchmark_claim: The case appears to claim that the agent should fill in the missing release-month values in the existing liked-songs note in `simple_note`.
case_analysis.actual_checked_outcome: The released AppWorld machinery loaded task `6f4b9a5_2`, paired the official task-input DB state with the retained task-output DB state, ran `official/ground_truth/evaluation.py::evaluate`, and marked success only if all eight registered `with test(...)` requirements passed: correct task-completion answer, helper-defined changed-model/changed-record semantics, exactly one updated note with id `3084`, exact song-to-artist and song-to-release-month mappings, and no other changed note fields beyond `content` and `updated_at`.
case_analysis.target_construction_review: The target is constructed from the exact start-state note in `official/dbs/simple_note.jsonl`, the supervisor task row in `official/dbs/supervisor.jsonl`, and `private_data.note_id`, `private_data.song_name_to_artist_names`, and `private_data.song_name_to_release_month_str`. The helper closure further fixes that `changed_model_names` ignores `supervisor.Task`, `changed_records` compares note ids and record hashes, and `changed_field_names` compares `to_dict()` fields after dropping `record_hash`.
case_analysis.evaluator_oracle_review: The pinned evaluator registers scoring outcomes only inside eight `with test(requirement)` blocks. The dynamic assignment `test.task_completed = ...` is not itself a scored test. `TestTracker.success` is exactly `pass_count == num_tests`, and `evaluate_task` returns that tracker for the loaded task id and retained end-state DB snapshot.
case_analysis.reward_wiring_aggregation_review: Our worker calls `evaluate_task`, serializes the returned tracker, and writes the released label directly from `tracker.success`; the campaign runner only records that result, and `audit_join_appworld68_blind_scores.py` rebinds the released label from `native_evaluator_output.json::tracker.success`. `Metric` only reports aggregates and does not alter any individual record's `TestTracker.success`.

official_benchmark_assessment.description: No retained official source shows the benchmark checking a different outcome. checklist_and_case_packet_assessment.description: The frozen checklist and case packet preserve the benchmark semantics, but their `native.undecided_if[0]` text and rationale do not exactly match the frozen strings that the pinned `appworld_checklist_semantics.py` contract now requires.
